concerns.text: FR-004 and SC-001 mandate evaluation of a 'Baseline' model (no mid-training) alongside FIM and NL-Control. Phase 4 (T023-T030) implements training for FIM and NL-Control only. There is no task to generate or load the Baseline model, violating the requirement to compare against a no-mid-training baseline.

FR-001 requires the system to 'fail the build' if overlap > 0 between GSM8K and LogiQA. T018 only describes 'implementing overlap check logic' but lacks a task to execute this check as a blocking gate before dataset generation or training, risking silent failure of the constraint.

FR-005 and SC-002 require statistical significance testing against *both* NL-Control and Baseline groups. T034/T035 describe generic 'compare groups' logic without explicitly mandating the inclusion of the Baseline in the t-test/Wilcoxon calculation, risking a partial implementation that omits a required comparison.

FR-001 explicitly requires verifying zero overlap with 'intermediate caches' of GSM8K examples. T018 only mentions checking 'GSM8K (train) and LogiQA (test) examples', omitting the specific validation against intermediate caching artifacts required by the spec.

Constitution Principle VII and Plan.md require 'format-based leakage verification' to ensure the pseudo-code structure does not encode test-set info. Phase 3 lacks a specific task to perform this verification, relying only on example overlap checks (T018), which is a semantic weakening of the leakage prevention constraint.

SC-005 requires measuring the 'rate of successful dependency graph construction' against a target. T020 only implements a 'depth-distribution validator' with error code VAR-001, missing the explicit task to calculate and report the success rate metric required by the success criterion.
